mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName, email, created_at AS createdAt FROM app_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName, email, created_at AS createdAt FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName, email, created_at AS createdAt FROM app_user WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (username, password_hash, display_name, email, created_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{createdAt})
